The '''''Darvro-class'' light freighter''' was a class of stealth cargo vessels widely used by the forces of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The craft was also designed for smuggling and was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to transport high-priority shipments through hostile territory. Though intended for escape or hiding rather than battle, the vessels did carry some armaments, but they were also fitted with [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanisms]] to prevent enemy forces from seizing valuable cargo.<ref name="SOR" />
